mapper.select: SELECT table_name_en, table_name_cn, column_name, column_cn_name, column_type, is_key, is_related, related_column_en, related_column_cn, biz_desc FROM table_schema WHERE BINARY table_name_en = BINARY #{name} OR BINARY table_name_cn = BINARY #{name} ORDER BY table_name_en, column_name, id

SELECT code_table_en_name, code_table_cn_name, code_value, code_desc FROM data_asset_code_kb WHERE BINARY code_table_en_name = BINARY #{name} OR BINARY code_table_cn_name = BINARY #{name} ORDER BY code_table_en_name, code_value, code_desc, id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT code_value) AS distinct_nonnull_codes, SUM(CASE WHEN code_value IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_code_rows FROM data_asset_code_kb WHERE BINARY code_table_en_name = BINARY #{name} OR BINARY code_table_cn_name = BINARY #{name}
